name: The Spirits of Sabil
source:
Do you want to interact with forest spirits like Ori from the Ori games? You can with The Spirits of Sabil! This is a free fanmade game where you can chat, play with, give gifts, and do romantic things with adorable guardian spirits! 

[From [url=https://whitecrocus.itch.io/the-spirits-of-sabil]itch.io[/url]]
